# `mise bootstrap dotfiles history diff`

- **Usage:** `mise bootstrap dotfiles history diff [FLAGS] [A] [B]`
- **Effect:** read-only
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/dotfiles/history/diff.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/dotfiles/history/diff.rs)

Compare checkpoints, or your files against one

Without arguments, shows unsaved changes: the files on disk against the latest checkpoint. With one reference, shows what that checkpoint changed since the one before it. With two, compares them.

## Arguments
- **`[A]`** — Numeric checkpoint ID, `latest`, `latest~N`, or `commit:<sha>`
- **`[B]`** — Compare `A` with this checkpoint instead of its predecessor

## Flags
- **`--operation`** — Compare an operation with the checkpoint it saved before it ran

  With no reference, uses the newest operation, ignoring later saves. With one reference, uses that operation. Fails if the operation's earlier checkpoint is unavailable instead of comparing an unrelated save.
- **`-p --patch`** — Print the full patch instead of a per-file summary
- **`--path <PATH>`** — Restrict to one path (a file or a directory)
- **`--exit-code`** — Exit 1 when the two sides differ
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Examples

Show unsaved changes

```
mise dot history diff
```

Show what checkpoint 12 changed

```
mise dot history diff 12
```

Print the full patch between two checkpoints

```
mise dot history diff 11 12 --patch
```

Show what the newest operation changed

```
mise dot history diff --operation
```
